en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate European building fronted by a large, formal garden or park. Visible text reads 'Sundsvall.' and 'Vängåvan.' on the image side, identifying the location as Sundsvall, Sweden, and the specific landmark as Vängåvan, a famous central park. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a printed 'BREVKORT' and 'CARTE POSTALE,' and spaces for an address and message. There is a visible date, '23/2 1916,' and a postal mark.
